entity: Groupon Shared Services Private Limited (Exhibit 21.1); Bengaluru engineering and support
summary: Earned leave is 1 day per 20 days worked, carried forward up to 45 days and paid out on leaving; a separate 12-day pool covers sickness and other reasonable causes. India's labour codes (in force 21 Nov 2025) apply alongside: where they overlap, the employee gets the more favourable rule.

locationAssumption.citation: Employees assumed to work in Bengaluru, Karnataka (Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1961)
locationAssumption.note: Groupon's careers page places Shared Services in Chennai (Tamil Nadu, a different state Act) and engineering and support in Bengaluru. Confirm per employee.

rule.citation: Leave is counted in working days; national and festival holidays are not charged

source.citation: 2027 festival dates follow the lunar calendar and Karnataka has not published its 2027 holiday list as of 5 Oct 2026
source.note: Requests in 2027 are refused until the list is published, the festival days are chosen and the calendar is signed off.

rule.citation: No statutory substitute day when a holiday falls on a weekly off day
Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1961 §15(1): "one day for every twenty days work performed" (adults); OSH Code 2020 §32 gives the same rate after 180 days worked in the year
KSCE Act §15(1): earned per days actually worked, credited here monthly
rule.note: The OSH Code's 180-day threshold is not applied: the State Act has none, and the employee gets the more favourable rule.

rule.citation: KSCE Act §15(7) as amended by Karnataka Act 8 of 2021: accumulated earned leave carried forward "shall not exceed forty five days"; leave refused by the employer carries forward without limit
rule.note: The OSH Code caps carry-forward at 30 days but lets the employee encash at year end; the more favourable State cap is applied.

rule.citation: The Act is silent on illness during earned leave; company policy decides
KSCE Act §15(13): on leaving, the employer pays for earned leave not taken (within two working days if dismissed; on the next pay day if the employee resigns)
KSCE Act §15(3): "leave with wages for a period not exceeding twelve days, on the ground of any sickness … or for any other reasonable cause" per 12 months of service
Granted on 1 January, pro-rated for joiners
Unused sick and other leave is not carried forward
rule.note: The Act does not provide for accumulation; verify Groupon policy.

rule.citation: Not applicable to the sick pool
Sick and other leave is not paid out

extras.label: Labour codes
extras.citation: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 §32 (in force 21 Nov 2025): 1 day per 20 worked after 180 days; carry-forward up to 30 days; encashment on demand at year end and on exit
extras.note: Karnataka's own OSH rules are still a draft (Jan 2026). The Ministry's FAQ says the employee keeps any more favourable state benefit; Bar & Bench calls the interaction unresolved. Counsel to confirm.

extras.label: Maternity
extras.citation: Maternity Benefit Act, 1961: up to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave
